name: @examples/rn-brownfield-ios
description: Native iOS host that links the XCFrameworks packaged by ../react-native through a local Swift package.

scripts.build: xcodebuild -project BrownfieldHost.xcodeproj -scheme BrownfieldHost -configuration Release -destination 'generic/platform=iOS Simulator' -derivedDataPath build CODE_SIGN_IDENTITY="" CODE_SIGNING_REQUIRED=NO build
scripts.ios: pnpm build && pnpm install:sim && pnpm launch
